description: Add WYSIWYG HTML editing to your WinForms application, with Word paste, spell checking and HTML source editing. Supports .NET 10 and .NET Framework 4.5+.
releaseNotes: Fixed image resize handles unexpectedly shrinking or distorting images on scaled displays. Dragging now follows the pointer correctly while preserving image padding, borders, links, relative paths, and native Undo/Redo. Canceled drags restore the original image. No public API changes.
title: SpiceLogic .NET WinForms HTML Editor Control
